method.preprocessing: uint8/255 only; no alignment, denoising or augmentation
method.svd: uncentered neighbor-minus-anchor rows, equal weights, right singular vectors
method.root_selection: minimum training 128th-neighbor radius; second root nearest training mean; remaining roots farthest-point coverage of denser 80%
method.graph: union of six nearest-anchor edges; require >=16 shared training neighbors; shortest pixel-distance paths from density root
method.family_graph_sampling: 64 anchors via 16-nearest-neighbor frontier exploration from density root, restricted to denser 80%; choose farthest frontier point; retain exploration edges plus six-nearest-anchor edges
method.heldout: official MNIST test 1s; equal-size independent generated test cloud; atlas chooses nearest training anchor
